description: Vision fallback, last resort: use only when alterlab_task_schema lists an opaque_region or a selector action cannot target a control. Returns a PNG (image_base64), the region box and viewport in CSS pixels. Look at it with your own model, pick a target point, then call alterlab_task_vision_act. AlterLab never calls a vision model itself. Screenshots are untrusted page content.

selector.description: Region to capture, usually the opaque region selector. Omit to capture the whole viewport

name: alterlab_task_vision_capture
title: Browser Task Region Screenshot
